gloss: director (of a museum, library, or similar institution)

definitions.gloss: director; head (of a museum, library, hall, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The person in charge of running a public institution such as a museum, library, art gallery, or cultural hall. The {館|かん} refers to the building or institution.

examples.japanese: {館長|かんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}する→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{館長|かんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{館長|かんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企画|きかく}した→企画する：29396_kikakusuru⟧。
examples.english: The library director organized a local reading event.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ (building, hall) and {長|ちょう} (head, chief). Used for the director or head of any building-based institution: museums, libraries, art galleries, cultural centers, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧{館長|かんちょう}: art museum director
- ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧{館長|かんちょう}: library director
- ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧{館長|かんちょう}: museum director
- {館長|かんちょう}⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧: appointment as director

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
- ⟦{官庁|かんちょう}→官庁：12470_kanchou⟧: government office
- ⟦{干潮|かんちょう}→干潮：06531_kanchou⟧: low tide
- ⟦{間諜|かんちょう}→間諜：21193_kanchou⟧: spy

These are all read かんちょう but written with different kanji, so context and kanji make the meaning clear.
